translated_title: June 7 Had 28 Homicides, the Day With Fewest Killings in the Last Decade: Security Cabinet
original_title: El 7 de junio hubo 28 homicidios, el día con menos asesinatos en la última década: Gabinete de Seguridad
author: Iván Evair Saldaña and César Arellano
meta_description: Mexico's Security Cabinet says June 7 saw 28 homicides, the country's lowest daily total in a decade. It beats the previous record of 29 set on May 15.
